answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 9587 Country: India Title: I want to ask you that after sighting of moon for eid ul zoha no cutting should be done Question: I want to ask you that after sighting of moon for eid ul zoha no cutting should be done Answer ID: 9587 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2306/2102=D/1429) One who intends to do Qurbani it is mustahab for him not to cut hair, nail etc until the Qurbani is done. One who does not intend to do Qurbani he is not asked to do so. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
